Name: ATMessagingEndpointTypeVS
Title: AT Messaging Endpoint Type ValueSet
Description: ValueSet of Endpoint Type Codings.

Name: ATMessagingEventTypeVS
Title: AT Message Event Type ValueSet
Description: Extensible ValueSet consisting of the Message Event Type Codings.

Name: AllLanguages
Title: All Languages
Description: This value set includes all possible codes from BCP-47 (see http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47)

Name: BundleType
Title: Bundle Type
Description: Indicates the purpose of a bundle - how it is intended to be used.

Name: SNOMEDCTClinicalFindings
Title: SNOMED CT Clinical Findings
Description: This value set includes all the "Clinical finding" [SNOMED CT](http://snomed.info/sct) codes - concepts where concept is-a 404684003 (Clinical finding (finding)).

Name: CommunicationCategory
Title: Communication Category
Description: Codes for general categories of communications such as alerts, instructions, etc.

Name: CommunicationNotDoneReason
Title: Communication Not Done Reason
Description: Codes for the reason why a communication did not happen.

Name: CommunicationRequestStatusReason
Title: CommunicationRequest Status Reason
Description: Example codes indicating the reason why a CommunicationRequest is on hold or revoked. Note that these are in no way complete and might not even be appropriate for some uses.

Name: CommunicationTopic
Title: Communication Topic
Description: Codes describing the purpose or content of the communication.

Name: EndpointEnvironment
Title: Endpoint Environment
Description: The environment type of the endpoint.

Name: EndpointPayloadType
Title: Endpoint Payload Type
Description: This is an example value set defined by the FHIR project, that could be used to represent possible payload document types.

Name: EndpointStatus
Title: Endpoint Status
Description: The status of the endpoint.

Name: EventStatus
Title: EventStatus
Description: Codes identifying the lifecycle stage of an event.

Name: HTTPVerb
Title: H T T P Verb
Description: HTTP verbs (in the HTTP command line). See [HTTP rfc](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231) for details.

Name: LinkRelationTypes
Title: Link Relation Types
Description: Link Relation Types defined at https://www.iana.org/assignments/link-relations/link-relations.xhtml#link-relations-1

Name: CommonLanguages
Title: Common Languages
Description: This value set includes common codes from BCP-47 (see http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47)

Name: ExampleMessageReasonCodes
Title: Example Message Reason Codes
Description: Example Message Reasons. These are the set of codes that might be used an updating an encounter using admin-update.

Name: MimeTypes
Title: Mime Types
Description: This value set includes all possible codes from BCP-13 (see http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp13)

Name: ProcedurePerformerRoleCodes
Title: Procedure Performer Role Codes
Description: This example value set defines the set of codes that can be used to indicate a role of a procedure performer.

Name: RequestIntent
Title: RequestIntent
Description: Codes indicating the degree of authority/intentionality associated with a request.

Name: RequestPriority
Title: RequestPriority
Description: Identifies the level of importance to be assigned to actioning the request.

Name: RequestStatus
Title: RequestStatus
Description: Codes identifying the lifecycle stage of a request.

Name: ResponseType
Title: Response Type
Description: The kind of response to a message.

Name: SearchEntryMode
Title: Search Entry Mode
Description: Why an entry is in the result set - whether it's included as a match or because of an _include requirement, or to convey information or warning information about the search process.

Name: TaskCode
Title: Task Codes
Description: Codes indicating the type of action that is expected to be performed

Name: TaskIntent
Title: Task Intent
Description: Distinguishes whether the task is a proposal, plan or full order.

Name: TaskStatus
Title: Task Status
Description: The current status of the task.

Name: TaskStatusReason
Title: Task Status Reason
Description: The current status reason of the task.

Name: ActReason
Title: v3 Code System ActReason
Description: A set of codes specifying the motivation, cause, or rationale of an Act, when such rationale is not reasonably represented as an ActRelationship of type "has reason" linking to another Act.  Examples:  Example reasons that might qualify for being coded in this field might be: "routine requirement", "infectious disease reporting requirement", "on patient request", "required by law".

Name: ParticipationMode
Title: ParticipationMode
Description: Identifies the primary means by which an Entity participates in an Act.
